Reverie: bicameral memory for AI-assisted development. Product reframe of codexCLI, decided 2026-05-06.

THE THESIS (Westworld parallel, structurally exact):
Codex entries function as bicameral subroutines. Agent reads at session start, "hears" the project's other voice, achieves conscious context about the codebase. Human writes (and agent writes back). Next session's voice is shaped by prior session's deposits. A two-voice (or n-voice) consciousness-coordination layer.

POSITIONING: "Bootstrapping GenAI consciousness for your projects."

PARENT BRAND: SeaBear Studios. URL: seabear.dev/reverie. Binary: rvr. Repo: seabearDEV/reverie (renamed from seabearDEV/codexCLI). NPM: @seabear/reverie (scoped — bare `rvr` taken on npm by abandoned aviation tool). Brew tap: seabearDEV/homebrew-reverie.

NAME-CLEARANCE 2026-05-06:

  Domains — reverie.{dev,ai,io} all taken. reverie.dev is a low-prominence Sitecore web-dev agency (©2022, tagline "we specialize in building custom web applications") — live but stale, no contact information, plausibly defunct. reverie.ai parked on Afternic; reverie.io on introvert.com broker (both make-offer, no listed price). Decided NOT to acquire any premium domain: seabear.dev/reverie was already canonical, parent-brand disambiguates from the agency, and any common-law rights the agency holds are scoped to Sitecore consulting (different segment from a developer-tool product). If a future session revisits acquisition, .ai and .io are the live offers; .dev would require approaching the agency.

  USPTO TESS — 205 results for "REVERIE" (89 Live / 116 Dead). 15 Live in IC 009 (downloadable software) or IC 042 (SaaS/computer services), our only risk classes. Bare "REVERIE" wordmark in our classes: (a) JTMD LTD. LLC / Reverie Sleep — REGISTERED 2018, IC 009, smart-mattress controller app (strongest existing claim); (b) Carbn LLC — PENDING, IC 042, interior-design SaaS; (c) Vegh Labs — PENDING, IC 009, journaling/spiritual reflection app. Compound marks (REVERIE 73 cannabis, REVERIE PRODUCTIONS audiovisual, TATTOO REVERIE, REVERIE3D real-estate VR, three Bandai Namco/Don't Nod game titles, HIGH REVERIE HOUSE branding, RÊVERIE RECORDS music) — none overlap developer tools. ZERO federal "REVERIE" mark in developer tools, dev infra, AI/ML, or agent software.

  RISK READ: Likelihood-of-confusion via DuPont should fail across goods between "developer-tool / AI memory layer" and the existing markets (mattresses, interior design, wellness). C&D risk real-but-low — none of the existing owners has a market reason to police dev tooling. If own-mark filing ever pursued: bare "REVERIE" in IC 009 would draw a citation against JTMD (survivable on goods-distinguishability but not free); "SEABEAR REVERIE" or "REVERIE by SeaBear" house-mark format clears easier. The closer risk remains the live agency at reverie.dev (Class 42 software services, common-law mark), which doesn't appear in TESS but exists in commerce since 2022.

  Decision unchanged: proceed with Reverie under SeaBear Studios parent brand, no own-mark filing, no premium domain. Source file: ~/Downloads/tmSearchResults2026-05-06.xlsx.

KEY NAMING CONVENTION (load-bearing):
"The codex" (lowercase) remains the generic noun for the data store / project knowledge layer. MCP tool names (codex_get, codex_set, codex_context, ...) keep the codex_* prefix because they manipulate the codex data structure, not the product. Reverie = product/brand. codex = data layer. This preserves MCP backwards compatibility AND is internally coherent: agents talk to "the codex," users invoke "rvr."

AUDIENCES (priority order):
1. AI agents (via MCP) — primary value driver, dominant surface
2. Humans (via CLI) — codex inspection, editing, hand work
3. Web (visualization, mindmap topology) — roadmap v1.1+

ORIGIN OF "REVERIE": Westworld reference — the subroutines that gave hosts consciousness by letting them access fragments of memories from previous loops. Codex entries are structurally that for AI agents. Tagline and Westworld nod chosen by user 2026-05-06; resonates personally and strategically.
